ENTIRE CONTRACT AVAILABLE ON WEBXTENDER For Metro Use Only Number: Date: APR 10 2007 CONTRACT BETWEEN METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY AND ZOLL MEDICAL CORPORATION FOR PURCHASE OF GOODS This contract is entered into on this first day of February, 2007, by and between THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY, a municipal corporation of the State of Tennessee ("Metro") and Zoll Medical Corporation, 269 Mill Road, Chelmsford, Massachusetts 01824 ("Contractor"). This contract consists of the following documents: This document, Requisition General Services Department, State Contract # 4032996 with Zoll, and Affidavits and Insurance. in the event of conflicting provisions, all documents shall be construed according to the following priorities: e Any properly executed amendment or change order to this contract (most recent with first priority), This contract, Requisition General Services Department, State Contract # 4032996 with Zoll, and Affidavits and Insurance.
1. Duties and Responsibilities of Contractor. Contractor agrees to provide and Metro agrees to purchase the following goods: i Automatic External Defibrillators and accessories
2. Delivery and Installation. a) All deliveries must be made pursuant to written purchase order issued by Metro's Purchasing Agent. Metro assumes no liability for any goods delivered without such purchase order. All deliveries shall be made to the address within thirty (30) days of the issuance of a purchase order. b) Installation is not required. ARCHIVE
